---
name: academy-module
description: Add a teaching module to AI Animation Academy with a clear learning objective reproducible exercise and documented limitation. Use when implementing new educational content inside the Next.js academy. Do not use when only changing site chrome or adding a raw prompt without a lesson structure.
---

# Academy module

- Inspect the existing Next.js route and content structure before creating files.
- Define one observable learning objective.
- Teach one workflow or concept per module.
- Include a reproducible exercise with required inputs and expected outcome.
- State model platform cost hardware or policy assumptions that affect reproduction.
- Link examples to repository-owned or appropriately licensed assets.
- Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` after implementation.
